announcement.note: (Monday; WotC said so in the Oct 12, 2026 announcement)

estimates.why: P(act) ~53%: WotC's Oct 12 'very likely ... very hard look at the Eldrazi package' (~60%), +10 for the Eldrazi family at ~20% on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp still #1 at 11.9%) and Broodscale Bloodchief #1 on MTGTop8 (13%) and S-tier for top-8 conversion on Spellslinger (68 top 8s in 30 days, best in the format), -17 for organic correction (Spellslinger: mono-green Broodscale share down from 11.2% to 5.8% and only C-tier; Rakdos Delirium is the most played deck at 6.4% and S-tier; the Nov 13 and Nov 14 Challenges were won by UR Aggro and UrzaTron with one Broodscale deck in each top 8; effective archetypes steady near 31; no new WotC wording as of Nov 16). Goldfish and Spellslinger disagree on the trend, so this is not averaged. x P(Command picked) ~30%: Emrakul, the Promised End, Basking Broodscale or Blade of the Bloodchief are the narrower enablers; Reddit opinion is split between Broodscale, Mycospawn and the Command. The Command is a flexible 4-of in 20% of all Modern decks (also in UrzaTron), which WotC avoids hitting.
#41 Legacy staple in ~12% of decks; WotC called Legacy Eldrazi proactive and fair. No ban pressure.
Not a Vintage restriction candidate; in Commander it is in 0.78% of EDHREC decks and not on the Game Changers list (Scryfall: 53 Game Changers, Command not among them).

summary: WotC's Oct 12 update warned it is 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package' if Eldrazi keeps sitting on top, and named Kozilek's Command as a bridge to Emrakul in Broodscale Combo. As of Nov 16 there is no new WotC word; the deck is still the most played on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp 11.9%) and MTGTop8 (Broodscale Bloodchief 13%), but the last four Challenges went to other decks, so a Nov 30 hit on the archetype is only slightly better than a coin flip. If WotC acts, Emrakul, Basking Broodscale or Blade of the Bloodchief is the likelier pick; the Command is a real but secondary target.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (last 2 weeks)
sources.takeaway: 580 decks (last 2 weeks): Broodscale Bloodchief #1 at 13%, Rakdos Aggro 10%, UW Control 8%, Amulet Titan 7%.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (full)
sources.takeaway: Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 11.9% (flat); Eldrazi-family decks ~20% combined (Eldrazi Tron 3.5%, Eldrazi 2.6%, Broodscale 1.2%+0.2%, Mono-Green Eldrazi 0.4%).

sources.title: Modern Format Staples
sources.takeaway: Kozilek's Command #14 staple, 20% of decks; Sowing Mycospawn #29 (16%), Emrakul #36 (15%), Blade of the Bloodchief #47 (13%), Basking Broodscale #48 (13%).

sources.title: Legacy Format Staples
sources.takeaway: #41 Legacy staple, ~12% of decks: no Legacy ban pressure.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 14)
sources.takeaway: 44 players, won by UrzaTron (4 Kozilek's Command main); one Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8, at 5-8th.

sources.title: r/ModernMagic: Broodscale ban talk
sources.takeaway: 'Most of us are expecting something from broodscale to be banned, particularly Kozilek's Command'; other threads favor Broodscale or Mycospawn.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 13)
sources.takeaway: 59 players, won by UR Aggro; one Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8, at 3-4th.

sources.title: Kozilek's Command
sources.takeaway: ~82K decks, 0.78% inclusion, not a Game Changer: no Commander ban pressure.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 12)
sources.takeaway: 53 players, won by Rakdos Delirium (no Command); only one Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8, at 3-4th.

sources.title: Banned and Restricted Announcement - October 12, 2026
sources.takeaway: No Modern changes; 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package'; Command named as a bridge to Emrakul; next B&R Nov 30.
